title: Aegis Protocol
tagline: AI agent rental platform with Ethereum smart contracts integration with polygon
description:
Aegis Protocol is an innovative decentralized platform designed to facilitate the creation, rental, and management of AI agents. Built on Ethereum and leveraging the Polygon network, it ensures scalability, low transaction costs, and high-speed operations. The platform empowers users to deploy AI agents as rentable services, enabling a decentralized marketplace for AI capabilities.

The backend is powered by Hardhat, a robust Ethereum development framework, which simplifies the deployment, testing, and management of smart contracts. These contracts govern the lifecycle of AI agents, including their creation, rental agreements, and payment processing. By utilizing blockchain technology, Aegis Protocol ensures trustless, transparent, and immutable transactions.

The frontend is developed using Next.js, a React-based framework, with TypeScript to ensure type safety and maintainability. The user interface is intuitive and responsive, allowing users to connect their wallets, view balances, track earnings, and manage expenses. The dashboard provides detailed insights into agent performance, rental history, and financial statistics, enhancing user experience.

AI functionality is integrated through backend services that connect to large language models (LLMs) like OpenAI and Anthropic. These services are accessed securely using renter-provided API keys, ensuring privacy and flexibility. The platform's modular architecture includes reusable components, hooks, and libraries, making it extensible and developer-friendly.

Aegis Protocol also supports deployment on the Polygon Amoy testnet, enabling developers to test and scale their applications efficiently. Comprehensive documentation guides users through setup and deployment, ensuring accessibility for both developers and end-users.

In essence, Aegis Protocol combines blockchain technology, AI integration, and modern web development to create a decentralized, scalable, and user-friendly platform for AI agent rentals. It represents a significant step forward in the intersection of AI and decentralized finance (DeFi).
how_its_made:
Aegis Protocol is built as a decentralized AI agent rental platform, leveraging Ethereum smart contracts and the Polygon network for scalability and cost efficiency. The backend is powered by Hardhat, a development framework for Ethereum, which facilitates the deployment and testing of smart contracts. These contracts manage agent creation, rentals, and payments, ensuring trustless and transparent transactions.

The frontend is developed using Next.js, a React-based framework, with TypeScript for type safety and scalability. It provides a seamless user experience for creating, renting, and managing AI agents. The dashboard integrates Web3 functionality, enabling users to connect their wallets, view balances, and track earnings or expenses. State management and API interactions are handled efficiently using React hooks and context.

AI capabilities are integrated through backend services that connect to large language models (LLMs) like OpenAI and Anthropic. These services are securely accessed via renter-supplied API keys, ensuring privacy and flexibility. The platform's API routes, built with Next.js' app router, handle LLM requests and other backend operations.

The system is designed to be modular and extensible, with reusable components, hooks, and libraries. It also supports deployment on the Polygon Amoy testnet, making it accessible for testing and scaling. Together, these technologies create a robust, user-friendly platform for decentralized AI agent rentals
